reader_summary.overview: Today's show is an episode of another podcast called Invisible Forces. It's hosted by insiders at Jefferies, Shannon Murphy and Erin Shea, who dive into unseen influences that are dramatically changing the global economy. Season 2 looks five years into the future to understand where we'll live, how we'll live, and what we'll buy.

key_points.text: What follows is the first episode of Season Two.
I hope you enjoy this show, and I suspect you will.
If you like what you hear, search for Invisible Forces anywhere you listen to podcasts.
